operations.description: One Hyperliquid wallet: account, positions, spot, per-period metrics and profile; with include=trades also the trade analysis. Request weight 1 (5 when include=trades). Returns original decimal strings, source timestamps, coverage, gaps, pagination and INCOMPLETE results.
